definition_en: having a strong dislike of or opposition to something
core_image: 身体往后一转，把脸从某物上挪开
scene: 父亲把菜推向桌子另一头。He was averse to any dish with cilantro.
sceneCN: 这里 averse 指「厌恶的、不愿的」（第 1 个义项：强烈反感）；句意：他讨厌任何加香菜的菜。

pos.zh: 厌恶的；反对的；不愿的（常作表语）

derivatives.zh: 厌恶；反感（averse + -ion 的名词化）
令人反感的（心理学用语，averse + -ive）

senses.title: Feeling strong dislike
senses.definition: feeling firm dislike or repugnance toward something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物怀有坚定反感或厌恶
senses.example: She was averse to discussing salaries at dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 她反感在饭桌上谈工资。
senses.why: The Latin root means turned away: dislike as the body turning from a thing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根义为「转开」：厌恶即身体从某物上转过去。

senses.title: Opposed in attitude
senses.definition: opposed to a proposal, practice, or course of action
senses.definitionCN: 对提案、做法或行动路线持反对态度
senses.example: The board was averse to the merger from the start.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会从一开始就反对这桩并购。
senses.why: Turning away extends from feelings to positions taken.
senses.whyCN: 「转开」从情绪延伸到所持立场。

senses.title: Unwilling to do something
senses.definition: reluctant or unwilling, as in not averse to helping
senses.definitionCN: 不情愿、不肯做，如 not averse to helping
senses.example: He is not averse to an extra shift when the pay doubles.
senses.exampleCN: 工资翻倍的话，他并不介意多加一个班。
senses.why: In the litotes not averse, the turning away is only mild.
senses.whyCN: 在低调说法 not averse 中，「转开」的程度很轻。

senses.title: Avoiding risk in economics
senses.definition: preferring certainty over gambles, as in risk-averse investors
senses.definitionCN: 宁取确定而回避赌博，如 risk-averse 投资者
senses.example: Risk-averse buyers chose the fixed-rate loan.
senses.exampleCN: 规避风险的买家选择了固定利率贷款。
senses.why: The turning-away image fits decision theory: turning from variance.
senses.whyCN: 「转开」意象契合决策论：从波动前转开身去。

senses.title: In psychology, producing avoidance
senses.definition: describing stimuli that organisms work to avoid, via the adjective aversive
senses.definitionCN: 指生物体极力回避的刺激，经由 aversive 一词
senses.example: Aversive shocks shaped the rats' learned avoidance.
senses.exampleCN: 厌恶电击塑造了大鼠习得的回避行为。
senses.why: The turning-away became a technical term for what drives it.
senses.whyCN: 「转开」变成了驱动回避行为的术语。

senses.title: Turned away in older English
senses.definition: in older or technical use, physically turned in a direction away from something
senses.definitionCN: 旧式或技术用法中，身体或器官背向某物
senses.example: Older botany texts described leaves averse to the stem.
senses.exampleCN: 旧植物学文献描述叶片背向茎干。
senses.why: This is the literal root sense that the moral senses grew away from.
senses.whyCN: 这是词根的字面本义，道德义项正是从它长出去的。

senses.title: Averse to novelty
senses.definition: disinclined toward new ideas, methods, or technology
senses.definitionCN: 对新观念、新方法或新技术不感兴趣甚至抵触
senses.example: The workshop proved averse to digital record-keeping.
senses.exampleCN: 那间作坊始终不愿改用数字记账。
senses.why: Attachment to the familiar is aversion pointed at the new.
senses.whyCN: 恋旧即厌恶指向了新事物。

senses.title: Aversely, in an unfavorable direction
senses.definition: in the adverb aversely, affecting something negatively or disadvantageously
senses.definitionCN: 副词 aversely 中，以负面或不利的方式影响某事
senses.example: The ruling bore aversely on small lenders.
senses.exampleCN: 这项裁决对小贷机构不利。
senses.why: Turned against a thing can mean acting against its interest.
senses.whyCN: 「转而背对」也可意味着对其利益不利。

intro.en: Averse comes from Latin aversus, turned away, the past participle of avertere, from ab, away, plus vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: averse 出自拉丁语 aversus「转开的」，是动词 avertere 的过去分词，由 ab（离开）+ vertere（转）构成。

items.en: The turn-root goes back to a reconstructed stem wer- meaning to bend or turn.
items.cn: 「转」的词根可追溯至重构词干 wer-「弯、转」。

items.en: averted, from ab, away, plus vertere, to turn, meant to turn something away.
items.cn: 拉丁语 avertere 由 ab「离开」+ vertere「转」构成，意为使转开。

items.en: aversus described a thing or face turned away; morally, turned against.
items.cn: aversus 描述背转的脸或物；道德层面即「反对」。

items.en: English took averse in the late sixteenth century, first literal, soon figurative.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪末借入 averse，先取字面义，很快转为比喻义。

items.en: The pattern averse to fixed in place, and risk aversion later entered economics.
items.cn: averse to 搭配固定下来，「风险规避」后来进入经济学。

items.en: Today averse is almost only predicative: people are averse to things.
items.cn: 如今 averse 几乎只作表语：人对事物 averse。

note.en: Group one gathers the vertere family and its spelling traps; group two gathers words of dislike.
note.cn: 第一组收 vertere 词族及拼写陷阱；第二组收厌恶义场的词。

entries.definition: unfavorable or harmful, acting against; describes conditions, not feelings.
entries.definitionCN: 不利的、有害的（起反作用）；形容条件而非心情，勿与 averse 混用。

entries.definition: to turn upside down; shares vertere with averse.
entries.definitionCN: 使倒转；与 averse 同享 vertere 词根。

entries.definition: unwilling and hesitating; milder than averse.
entries.definitionCN: 不情愿、犹豫；语气比 averse 温和。

entries.definition: unwilling out of dislike; also predicative, as loath to admit.
entries.definitionCN: 因厌恶而不愿；同样常作表语，如 loath to admit。

entries.definition: not minded to do something; formal and mild.
entries.definitionCN: 无意于做某事；正式而温和。

entries.definition: naturally opposed in feeling; stronger and more settled than averse.
entries.definitionCN: 天性相斥的；比 averse 更强、更持久。

entries.definition: actively unfriendly; aversion turned into aggression.
entries.definitionCN: 怀敌意的；厌恶转为攻击性的状态。

normalIntro.en: Break it as a-verse: your body turns a verse away, the opposite direction from the thing.
normalIntro.cn: 拆成 a-verse 记：身体像翻页一样把某物翻到背面去。

normal.en: av- from ab- means away: averse turns away, adverse turns against.
normal.cn: av- 出自 ab-「离开」：averse 是转身躲开，adverse 是迎面作对。

normal.en: Risk-averse is the fixed economic collocation.
normal.cn: risk-averse 是经济学固定搭配：规避风险的。

normal.en: not averse to is the polite way of saying quite willing.
normal.cn: not averse to 是「还挺乐意」的礼貌说法。

normal.en: The family holds together: avert, aversion, aversive all carry the same turning.
normal.cn: 词族提示：avert、aversion、aversive 都带同一个「转」。

normal.en: Averse needs a person; adverse needs weather, effects, conditions.
normal.cn: averse 用于人，adverse 用于天气、效果、条件。

abstract.en: Feel your shoulders angle away from the offer.
abstract.cn: 感觉肩膀朝提议的反方向偏过去。

abstract.en: Averse is a no spoken with the whole spine.
abstract.cn: averse 是用整条脊柱说出的「不」。

abstract.en: Picture a compass needle swinging off north and holding there.
abstract.cn: 想象罗盘针偏开正北并停在那里。

examples.en: Conservative savers are averse to putting money in equities.
examples.cn: 保守的储户不愿把钱投入股市。

examples.en: He was not averse to a little flattery now and then.
examples.cn: 他偶尔也不排斥听两句恭维。

examples.en: The committee remained averse to any delay in the schedule.
examples.cn: 委员会反对日程出现任何延误。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「恶我死」——那东西一靠近他就喊「恶我死」，赶紧把脸转开

root: 出自拉丁语 aversus「转开的」，为 avertere 的过去分词，由 ab-（离开）+ vertere（转）构成，与 reverse、convert、divert 同属 vertere 词族。16 世纪末进入英语，先表「背向」后转指心理上的「厌恶、反对」，如今几乎只作表语形容词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses fan out from the one root image of turning away: dislike, opposition, unwillingness, risk avoidance, and the technical senses in psychology and older prose.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「转开」这一根意象展开：厌恶、反对、不情愿、规避风险，以及心理学与旧文体中的技术义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body pivoting so its face no longer meets the thing.
core.cn: 核心意象：身体转过去，脸不再迎向那事物。

branches.en: THE FEELING SIDE: dislike and the opposition it becomes.
branches.cn: 情感一面：反感及其化成的反对。

branches.en: THE WILLINGNESS SIDE: mild turning in not averse to.
branches.cn: 意愿一面：not averse to 中的轻度转开。

branches.en: THE TECHNICAL SIDE: risk economics and avoidance learning.
branches.cn: 技术一面：风险经济学与回避学习。

branches.en: THE LITERAL SIDE: turned away in old botany and anatomy.
branches.cn: 字面一面：旧植物学、解剖学中的背向。

branches.en: THE SET SIDE: habit turned from novelty, effect turned against interest.
branches.cn: 定型一面：习惯背对新事物，作用背离利益。

intro.en: Averse is ab- plus versus: the prefix says away, the participle says turned.
intro.cn: averse 的结构是 ab-（离开）加 versus（转开的）。

latinIntro.en: The vertere family is one of Latin's most productive: every turn in English often hides it.
latinIntro.cn: vertere 词族是拉丁语最高产的词族之一：英语里许多「转」都藏着它。
